title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - 𝑅𝑒𝓂𝒾𝓁𝒾𝒶, Mistress beyond the Stairway 🦇 ~ The Young Descendent of Tepes (Snake-Taboo-mix)
description:
❝ ℭ𝔞𝔫 𝔶𝔬𝔲 𝔯𝔢𝔪𝔢𝔪𝔟𝔢𝔯 𝔥𝔬𝔴 𝔪𝔞𝔫𝔶 𝔰𝔩𝔦𝔠𝔢𝔰 𝔬𝔣 𝔟𝔯𝔢𝔞𝔡 𝔶𝔬𝔲 𝔥𝔞𝔳𝔢 𝔢𝔞𝔱𝔢𝔫 𝔲𝔫𝔱𝔦𝔩 𝔫𝔬𝔴? ❞
ㅤ- 𝑅𝑒𝓂𝒾𝓁𝒾𝒶 𝒮𝒸𝒶𝓇𝓁𝑒𝓉, Touhou 6 Kōmakyō ~ EoSD (2003)

Did a special arrangement of Remilia Scarlet's stage theme The Young Descendent of Tepes from Touhou 6 Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil
(ft. Malicious Intent and Snake Eyes) from Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon and Mega Man ZX respectively)
. This is the first part of a set of two remixes for Remilia Scarlet, with this one being a remix of her stage theme, and the next one being her... you know...

This particular mashup was an idea I had in my head for the past couple years now. Remilia Scarlet's stage theme is one of my favorite final stage themes in Touhou, and two extra mixed tracks are my favorite tracks from each game they're in, and they work so well with her stage theme.

Anyways, up next is Septette for the Dead Princess!! Look forward to that, bros!!!
